title: User Segmentation
insights:
Dataset Summary

The dataset contains a total of 44,031 events recorded from 499 users over a period from December 24, 2025 to January 20, 2026. There are 80 unique event types within the application category.

User Segmentation Findings

Segment: Outliers

PERSONA NAME: "Occasional Users"

PROFILE: This segment consists of 34 users, representing 6.8% of the total user base. They have an average of 361.8 events and a booking rate of 35.3%.

TARGETING RECOMMENDATION: Implement personalized follow-up emails to encourage these users to book again, highlighting their past activity and offering incentives.

Segment: Main User Group

PERSONA NAME: "Casual Users"

PROFILE: This segment includes 465 users, making up 93.2% of the total users. They average 68.2 events per user, with a booking rate of 4.7%.

TARGETING RECOMMENDATION: Send push notifications with special offers or reminders to encourage bookings, as this segment shows low engagement despite high event counts.

Overall Assessment

The user base appears to have a healthy distribution with a significant majority (93.2%) being casual users. However, the low booking rate of 4.7% among the main user group indicates a need for improved engagement strategies. The ratio of high-value users (Occasional Users with a 35.3% booking rate) to low-engagement users (Casual Users with a 4.7% booking rate) suggests that while there are some valuable users, the majority are not converting effectively. This indicates an opportunity for targeted marketing efforts to enhance user engagement and conversion rates.
